interpretation: The only measured result in this report is the posthoc deterministic branch at 210/274 = 0.766423, with five fixes and zero regressions versus the 205/274 strict branch. Values above 0.90 are candidate-coverage or adjudication projections, not achieved benchmark scores.
limitations: The 11 rows were researched after benchmark outcome exposure, so this is targeted posthoc analysis rather than an independent holdout evaluation.
An oracle reads per-row correctness and is not a deployable routing policy.
Five evidence rows use the frozen image-judge partition and were deliberately not substituted into the measured deterministic branch.
Three official answers conflict with all existing scored outcomes and need protocol-level re-adjudication before they can count as measured fixes.
val_0194 relies on a third-party copy while the official MEB PDF endpoint is unavailable.
A preregistered policy and untouched holdout are required before making a production or 0.90 accuracy claim.
